description: This file defines the SensorGauge class, which creates and manages gauge components for sensors in a UI, including event handling for interactions like double-click and right-click, and dynamically updating gauge values based on sensor data.

classes.name: SensorGauge
classes.description: Class for creating and managing sensor gauges in the UI, including event handling and dynamic updates.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge component for a given sensor with event listeners.

methods.name: createGaugeBody
methods.description: Builds the gauge UI component, sets up sensor data updates, and event handling.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays a context menu for gauge customization.

methods.name: fillGaugeMenuItems
methods.description: Populates the context menu with sensor categories and sensors.

methods.name: handleDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click event to detach the sensor gauge.

methods.name: createRadial
methods.description: Creates and configures a Radial gauge object.
